info.name: PANGAEA Data Download Services DOI Filter OAI-PMH API

params.name: verb
params.description: OAI-PMH verb specifying the request type

params.name: metadataPrefix
params.description: Metadata format to return. Required for ListIdentifiers, ListRecords, and GetRecord verbs.

params.name: identifier
params.description: Unique identifier of the record to retrieve. Required for GetRecord verb. Format: oai:pangaea.de:doi:10.1594/PANGAEA.{id}

params.name: set
params.description: Set specification for selective harvesting. Optional for ListIdentifiers and ListRecords verbs.

params.name: from
params.description: UTC date for selective harvesting - only return records modified on or after this date. ISO 8601 format.

params.name: until
params.description: UTC date for selective harvesting - only return records modified on or before this date. ISO 8601 format.

params.name: resumptionToken
params.description: Token for resuming a previous incomplete list request. Mutually exclusive with other parameters except verb.

items.docs: OAI-PMH 2.0 endpoint supporting all standard verbs: Identify, ListMetadataFormats, ListSets, ListIdentifiers, ListRecords, and GetRecord. All responses are returned as XML.
